title: Record a decision on a pending claim
description: Find a claim by its reference in Meridian Claims Desk, record an approve or reject decision with an audit note, and return the confirmation code.
goal: Record the supplied decision outcome on the supplied claim reference in Meridian Claims Desk, entering the supplied decision note, and capture the confirmation code and decided amount from the receipt screen.

inputs.name: claim_id
inputs.description: Claim reference as printed on the claim record.

inputs.name: outcome
inputs.description: Decision to record against the claim.

inputs.name: note
inputs.example: Within plan limits, provider in network, no prior duplicate.
inputs.description: Audit note explaining the decision. Redacted from logs and evidence.

outputs.name: confirmation_code
outputs.description: Receipt code the claims system issues for the decision.

outputs.name: decided_amount
outputs.description: Claim amount as shown on the receipt, used to confirm the right record was acted on.
